correctness.rationale: The affine predator recurrence has a unique 3-cycle for every 0<=rho<1. Its closed form produces a positive-factor times the alternating cross-crop functional, with background input and same-crop terms cancelling exactly. Independent symbolic factoring establishes the type-II positive rational factor and the type-III rational factor containing AB+AC+BC-K^2; all other factors are positive on the exact domain, proving a single and only single positive switch. The phase-rotation argument excludes orientation differences at periods 1 and 2. Six thousand and sixty-six exact rational assertions support the computed examples; the proof is analytic and covers infinite parameter domains. These statements concern periodic predation proxies, not all possible ecological dynamics.

originality.rationale: The inspected seed-predator masting papers document temporal predator response and type-II/type-III functional differences but do not state the exact three-crop reversal, its half-saturation threshold or retention invariance. Related mathematical calendar-reversal full primary results address a reciprocal-density Beverton–Holt map, stage-structured population invasion, or Holling-III prey-management treatments rather than the periodic affine seed-predator stock and its type-specific total loss. The classical divided-difference identity and Holling functional forms are explicitly excluded as new. Priority is provisional given the remaining full-text and indexing risks.
residual_risks: Some other potentially relevant mathematical calendar-ordering or seed-predation papers remain uninspected in complete primary text; the closest two repository results were read in full.
An unindexed earlier periodically forced linear-predator or three-crop satiation analysis could cover the exact theorem.
The university-hosted PDF of the 2004 primary work redirected to authentication, although its author-uploaded full-text reproduction was read.
The scientific model has no field validation or independent scientific audit.

value.rationale: The motivating ecological distinction between predator numerical lag and type-II versus type-III prey switching is established in the inspected masting literature. The result gives a complete nontrivial scheduling classification with a natural crop-dependent K threshold, an exact independent-of-survival robustness principle, and a sharp minimal period. The exact feasibility witness shows the reversal is not an artifact of negative seed escape. The finite-dimensional calculation is analytically complete and useful as a transparent model benchmark; biological field or evolutionary conclusions are expressly not claimed.
